components.name: curl command-line HTTP/HTTPS client
components.changes: No source changes. The local build script fixes the configure arguments for this board, links the Mbed TLS shared libraries, bakes in the CA bundle path, and forces ac_cv_func_eventfd=no because the kernel has no eventfd(); the cross-configure probe can only compile, never run, so it would otherwise take the eventfd wakeup path and fail at run time.
issues: INFO

curl license retained with the Copyright and permission notice; deployed binary reproduced byte for byte from the pinned source, and https:// transfers including certificate rejection were exercised on hardware

components.name: Mbed TLS shared libraries used by curl
components.changes: No source changes. sdk-src/configs/mbedtls-config.h selects a client-only TLS 1.2/1.3 configuration for this board, and the build script produces the three shared objects (SHARED=1) so every TLS client here links one copy instead of embedding its own; upstream is dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later and this build is distributed under Apache-2.0.
issues: INFO
Apache-2.0 chosen from the dual grant; no GPL-only code linked, and all three deployed objects reproduced byte for byte from the pinned source

components.name: Mozilla CA root bundle used by curl
components.changes: Unmodified published bundle (the source tree also carries the provenance README and the installer). It is data, not code: the NSS certdata.txt metadata is MPL-2.0 and the certificate bodies are public data published by each CA.
issues: INFO
Bundle byte-identical to the published file; the rootfs copy hash matches the staged source and https:// verification with a self-signed rejection was exercised on hardware
